title: Tone.js
hero_prompt: A Klee/Kandinsky-style Bauhaus gouache painting, wide banner. A window frame stands in for a browser pane; sound waves pass through it and resolve into a grid of colored bars and beats, like a loom weaving one wandering line into steady rhythmic bands, a woman's silhouette at the sill reaching into the pattern. Hand-made Klee/Kandinsky Bauhaus gouache, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: Bold geometric gouache icon: a single thick wave-line crossing a square window frame and resolving into three solid colored bars, flat high-contrast shapes, no fine detail, reads at small size.
